newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Konsortium in courier tie-up.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Konsortium in courier tie-up.

text.p: Malaysian transportation firm Konsortium Perkapalan Bhd (KPB) said it has signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to establish a joint venture international courier service in Malaysia.
A company statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange said late on Wednesday that the agreement was between KPB, national postal service Pos Malaysia Bhd and airline Transmile Air Services Sdn Bhd.
The new company, to be known as Courier Express Networks Sdn Bhd, would be involved in the local and international transportation of cargo and documents by air, sea and land, the statement said.
A senior company official at KPB said that new company would absorb much of the existing cargo business of Pos Malaysia.
He did not reveal any details of the shareholding structure of the venture.
KPB is controlled by Mirzan Mahathir, the eldest son of Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad.
